# A09-S47: Political selection

Extract from the operator’s source text. Transport metadata, signatures and marked context omitted.

[…]

I was thinking that GPT-3 for example still goes around thinking that Donald Trump is president because it was finished in the summer of 2020.

Maybe we could also think that Rasmus Paludan and Stram Kurs are not on the list because we are from May 2022? 

Exactly him is probably too dangerous to invite. Then there are other parties that he's probably also associated with, so you never know. But maybe smart not to make it too easy for him. What do you think?
